responsibility: Declares the SH target command-line options and associated option variables/masks. It is the option-table source that maps -m CPU selections, FPU modes, endianness, PIC/FDPIC, atomic models, tuning knobs, ABI toggles, and SH-specific code-generation features into backend state consumed by sh.h, sh.cc, and the machine descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Contains the generated-option-table source for SH -m switches and option variables, unlike sh.h which defines target configuration macros, sh.cc which consumes those settings in backend code, and sh.md which uses them to condition instruction patterns and attributes.
